raw_text:
# Title

FIXES: Fix malformed stdin exceptions in hooks and restore ast.AST fuzzable status in harvest.

# Scope

Modify two files:
1. `harness/hooks/_common.py`: In the `read_input` function, raise `HookInputError` (which is a subclass of `ValueError`) instead of `ValueError` on JSON decode errors and non-dict inputs.
2. `harness/rebuild/harvest.py`: In the `_is_fuzzable_annotation` function, when `isinstance(node, ast.Attribute)` has a base ID of `'ast'`, return `True` so that `ast.AST` (and all other AST classes) are classified as fuzzable.

# Non-Goals

- Do NOT modify any files other than `harness/hooks/_common.py` and `harness/rebuild/harvest.py`.
- Do NOT change the definition of `HookInputError` in `harness/hooks/_common.py`.
- Do NOT change `_is_fuzzable_annotation` for any types other than `ast.*`.

# Inputs

- `harness/hooks/_common.py` - containing the hook `read_input` helper.
- `harness/rebuild/harvest.py` - containing `_is_fuzzable_annotation`.

# Deliverables

- `harness/hooks/_common.py` updated to raise `HookInputError` instead of `ValueError` in `read_input`.
- `harness/rebuild/harvest.py` updated so `_is_fuzzable_annotation` returns `True` for `ast.AST` (when base of the attribute is `'ast'`).
- The entire pytest test suite (including `tests/adversarial/test_P1_scaffold.py`, `tests/adversarial/test_diff_fuzzer_structured.py`, `tests/adversarial/test_rebuild_p0_pins.py`, and hooks unit tests) passes.
